metadata.title: Criptic Digital - AI & Ci gaban Yanar Gizo
metadata.description: Taimaka wa kasuwanci da kamfanoni don ginawa da haɓaka shafukan yanar gizo, kula da tsarin, da kuma amfani da hanyoyin da AI ke tafiyar da su don haɓaka.

headlines.line1: Shafukan Yanar Gizo Masu Wayo. Tsarin Zamani.
headlines.line2: Hanyoyin da AI ke Tafiyar da su.

hero.description: Taimaka wa kasuwanci da kamfanoni don ginawa da haɓaka shafukan yanar gizo, kula da tsarin, da kuma amfani da hanyoyin da AI ke tafiyar da su don haɓaka.
hero.cta1: Samu Shafin Yanar Gizo na Zamani

about.title: Game da Ni
about.subtitle: Mai Binciken Blockchain, Mai Haɓaka Yanar Gizo na AI, da kuma Mai Ba da Shawara kan Fasaha.
about.description: Manufata ita ce in ƙarfafa kasuwanci ta hanyar taimaka musu su rungumi makomar fasaha. Na kware wajen gina shafukan yanar gizo da aka haɗa da AI, sabunta aikace-aikace, da kuma ba da ingantaccen kulawa ga tsarin don tabbatar da ayyuka marasa matsala da ci gaba mai dorewa.

services.title: Ayyukana
services.description: Samar da cikakkun hanyoyin magance matsaloli don ɗaukaka kasancewar ku a duniyar dijital da ingancin aiki.

servicesData.title: Ci gaban Shafin Yanar Gizo Mai Amfani da AI
servicesData.description: Shafukan yanar gizo masu sauri, masu amsawa, da masu basira waɗanda aka keɓance don bukatun kasuwancin ku.

servicesData.title: Haɓaka Shafin Yanar Gizo & Aikace-aikacen Yanar Gizo
servicesData.description: Sabunta tsoffin tsarin ku da sabbin fasahohi don ingantaccen aiki.

servicesData.title: Kulawar Tsari & Sabar
servicesData.description: Ingantattun haɓaka software, tallafin sabar, da sa ido kan aiki.

servicesData.title: Shawara kan Fasaha mai Zaman Kanta
servicesData.description: Shawarwari da dabarun fasaha da aka keɓance don taimakawa kasuwancin ku ya haɓaka.

servicesData.title: Shawara kan Blockchain & Web3
servicesData.description: Jagorancin ƙwararru ga kamfanoni masu hangen nesa da ke shiga sararin Web3.

projects.title: Aikina
projects.description: Zaɓin ayyukan da ke nuna ƙwarewata da sha'awata don gina sabbin hanyoyin dijital na zamani.

projectsData.title: CryptoDaHausa
projectsData.description: Dandalin samar da abun ciki na ilimin blockchain a cikin yaren gida, wanda ke sa batutuwa masu rikitarwa su zama masu sauƙin fahimta.

projectsData.title: Kayan Aikin AI na Haɓaka Aiki
projectsData.description: Jerin aikace-aikacen da AI ke tafiyar da su da aka shirya akan GitHub don haɓaka aiki da tsarin aiki.

projectsData.title: Turawa Shafin Yanar Gizon Kamfani
projectsData.description: Shafin yanar gizo na zamani da na ƙwararru don abokin ciniki na kamfani, wanda aka bayar a matsayin aikin kai.

projectsData.title: Ayyukan Buɗaɗɗen Lambar
projectsData.description: Gudunmawa ga ayyukan buɗaɗɗen lambar daban-daban, wanda ke nuna ƙwarewar haɓaka haɗin gwiwa.

whyChooseMe.title: Me yasa za a zabe ni?
whyChooseMe.description: Isar da daraja ta hanyar gogewa, sabbin abubuwa, da kuma sadaukar da kai ga nasarar ku.

items.title: Shafukan Yanar Gizo da aka haɗa da AI

blog.title: Shafin & Albarkatu
blog.description: Fahimta kan AI, sauye-sauyen dijital, blockchain, da fasahar kasuwanci.

posts.title: Haɓakar AI a Ci gaban Yanar Gizo
posts.excerpt: Gano yadda Hankalin Ƙirƙira ke kawo sauyi ga yadda muke ginawa da hulɗa da shafukan yanar gizo.

posts.title: Sauye-sauyen Dijital ga Kasuwancin Gida
posts.excerpt: Jagora ga ƙanana da matsakaitan kasuwanci kan yadda za su yi amfani da fasaha don haɓaka.

posts.title: Fahimtar Blockchain Fiye da Kuɗin Intanet
posts.excerpt: Binciko yiwuwar fasahar blockchain a masana'antu daban-daban fiye da harkokin kuɗi.

contact.description: Kuna da wani aiki a zuciya ko kawai kuna son yin gaisuwa? Ina son jin daga gare ku.
